correctness.rationale: At the specified field, energy equals a constant plus 2J times the sum of squares of degree deviations from one. For odd order the sum is positive odd, and the first two realizable values are 1 and 3. All three-deviation edge-subgraphs decompose uniquely into degree-one endpoint paths, a possible triangle of three degree-two exceptions, and isolated vertices. Exact symbolic double-factorial enumeration follows. Exhaustive finite states for n=5,7 and arithmetic checks agree; remainder begins at energy E0+8J.
